summary.text: Greg VanWoerkom is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 88 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists his House service as beginning in 2019.
He previously worked as district director for U.S. Representative Bill Huizenga and as a senior policy advisor to former U.S. Representative Pete Hoekstra.

paragraphs.text: VanWoerkom lives in Norton Shores, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Calvin College and a master's degree in political leadership from George Washington University.
He has served on the board of the United Way of the Lakeshore, as board president of Western Michigan Christian High and Middle School, and as a member of the Muskegon Rotary Club.
VanWoerkom was majority vice chair of the House Government Operations Committee in 2021-2022 and a minority vice chair of the Tax Policy Committee in 2023-2024.
In 2025-2026 he serves on the House Appropriations Committee.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Kiel Reid in the general election on November 3, 2026.
